title: Urgency: Crash AAPS after update samsung One UI 4.1
body:
Good evening,
Following an update from samsung I can no longer use aaps I really need help urgently please

Reporting bugs
--------------
- 03/05/2022 a 20h01 Crash AAPS after update samsung One UI 4.1 (Android 12)
- 3.0.0.1 and version 3.0.0.2
- logs in attachments
